name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.205.0 — Genesis now stops after the journey stories for JJ's approval in Storybook: it probes /index.json, prints one verified URL per journey, and an `approve` step writes docs/design/approval.json recording journeys, the beats hash, screens, and composite states, with no file hashes captured. ROADMAP derives from that record, printing `approved:` lines per journey and having its placement check read the approval's screens. 7.204.0 — Genesis design stage gains the kit and the journey stories (specs/20260926/05): after the design brief, DESIGN_KIT has Fable author tokens, shell and one composite per pattern row with a story per declared state, installs Storybook by a printed recipe, and kit-landed runs the contract check, requires .storybook/main.*, builds Storybook and requires iframe.html plus a state story per declared state; DESIGN_JOURNEYS writes a beats file per seed journey, and journeys-drawn requires one journey story per journey that imports its beats and calls step(), bans primitive imports under the journeys directory, and finds a journey+play-fn entry per journey in the rebuilt index. HANDOFF stamps design {kit, tokens, rules}. 7.203.0 — Genesis gains the DESIGN_BRIEF state after the zero-day gate is green: a web host now writes docs/design/brief.md and fills the host's rules tables under Fable, catalog-inventory.js derives the installed catalog inventory the driver verifies mechanically, a design-brief skill and brief/paths templates ship the workbench, design-contract-check.js gains overrides for the new state, and the gray mock app stops auto-picking the stack or skipping the scaffold — genesis always picks and scaffolds, reading the mock app's approval record for the last time at this state's entry.
